I couldn't find how to declare a list of items inside a request body in these FastAPI doc excerpts. They cover single-model bodies only, not nested models or list fields.

Here's what they do cover, which is the starting point:

- **Declaring a body:** To declare a request body, you use Pydantic models with all their power and benefits.[1]
- **How FastAPI recognizes a body parameter:** If the parameter is declared to be of the type of a Pydantic model, it will be interpreted as a request body.[5]

```python
from fastapi import FastAPI
from pydantic import BaseModel


class Item(BaseModel):
    name: str
    description: str | None = None
    price: float
    tax: float | None = None


app = FastAPI()


@app.post("/items/")
async def create_item(item: Item):
    return item
```

For an order containing a list of items, see the **"Body - Nested Models"** page of the FastAPI tutorial (https://fastapi.tiangolo.com/tutorial/body-nested-models/). It should explain list fields and models nested inside other models.
